display.title: Chart The Drowned Coast
display.description: Follow the coast branch to an Ocean Monument and return with prismarine proof.

tracker.text: Defeat guardians near the drowned coast: {objective_progress_count}/{objective_count}.
tracker.complete_text: The coast is quiet enough to map.

tracker.text: Bring 8 prismarine shards from the monument.
tracker.complete_text: The prismarine is sorted for the atlas margin.

proof.text: Bring prismarine proof from the drowned coast.

return.text: Return to the cartographer with the coast survey.

start: The coast mark is {distance} blocks {direction}, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Find the monument, survive the guardians, and bring prismarine.
reminder: Ocean Monument near {target_x}, {target_z}. The atlas needs prismarine and proof that you reached the drowned stone.
turn_in: Salt in the paper, prismarine in the hand. The atlas has its coast.
already_completed: The drowned coast is already charted.
unavailable: The atlas did not choose the coast with you.
inactive: The coast page is not open right now.
missing_target: The prismarine is not enough unless you reached the monument itself.
missing_proof: Bring prismarine proof from the coast before I ink the page.
locate_failed: The sea refuses a clean mark from this table today.
